[1] MCP4725.pdf 第2页
4.4 Differential Nonlinearity (DNL)

Differential nonlinearity error (Figure 4-2) is the measure of step size between codes in actual transfer function. The ideal step size between codes is 1 LSB. A DNL error of zero would imply that every code is exactly 1 LSB wide. If the DNL error is less than 1 LSB, the DAC guarantees monotonic output and no missing codes. The DNL error between any two adjacent codes is calculated as follows:

EQUATION 4-3:

D N L = \frac {\Delta V _ {O U T} - L S B}{L S B}

Where:

\begin{array}{r l r} \Delta V _ {\text {OUT}} & = & \text {The measured DAC output} \\ & & \text {voltage difference between two} \\ & & \text {adjacent input codes.} \end{array}

[2] MCP4725.pdf 第2页
4.2 LSB

The least significant bit or the ideal voltage difference between two successive codes.

EQUATION 4-1:

L S B _ {I d e a l} = \frac {V _ {R E F}}{2 ^ {n}} = \frac {(V _ {F u l l S c a l e} - V _ {Z e r o S c a l e})}{2 ^ {n} - 1}

Where:

\begin{array}{r c l} V _ {R E F} & = & \text {The reference voltage} = V _ {D D} \text {in the} \\ & & \text {MCP4725. This V_{REF} is the ideal} \\ & & \text {full scale voltage range} \\ n & = & \text {The number of digital input bits.} \\ & & (n = 1 2 \text {for MCP4725}) \end{array}

[3] MCP4725.pdf 第2页
4.3 Integral Nonlinearity (INL) or Relative Accuracy

INL error is the maximum deviation between an actual code transition point and its corresponding ideal transition point (straight line). Figure 2-5 shows the INL curve of the MCP4725. The end-point method is used for the calculation. The INL error at a given input DAC code is calculated as:

EQUATION 4-2:

I N L = \frac {\left(V _ {O U T} - V _ {I d e a l}\right)}{L S B}

Where:

\begin{array}{r c l} \mathrm{V} _ {\text {Ideal}} & = & \text {Code*LSB} \\ \mathrm{V} _ {\text {OUT}} & = & \text {The output voltage measured at} \\ & & \text {the given input code} \end{array}

For the MCP4725, VDD is 4.096 V and the measured output step between two adjacent codes is 1.25 mV. What is the signed DNL in LSB? Show how the ideal step enters the calculation.

*   **典型值 (Typical Value)**：资料 [4] 和 [8] 中明确给出，MCP4725 的 DNL 典型值为 $\pm 0.2$ LSB。
*   **输入电压**：$V_{DD} = 4.096 \text{ V}$。

$$L S B_{ideal} = \frac{4.096}{4096} = 0.001 \text{ V} = 1 \text{ LSB}$$
